method: Official PDF first-page renders visually compared with current source geometry; no live browser comparison in this audit

findings.description: Housing uses rectangular walls/endcaps instead of illustrated shaped retaining profile; connector appearance is schematic custom extrusion, not verified CAD.
Guide and optimizer CSG use a constant-width capsule extrusion, missing the undercut cutter profile shown in official installation section.
Housing endcap corner lies outside current capsule cavity in the seated pose. This is a mismatch between current app shapes, not supplier tolerance measurement.
P versus R part pairing and push versus insert/slide sequence broadly agree with instructions. R drawing labels release travel 15mm; exact current engagement and orientation have not been verified.
Catalog has unresolved guessed/shared values for other models marked autoApplicable; all 19 model documents were not audited in this pass.
